scope: Document input review, stage-specific transport mass, target-bound action tasks; not recommendation accuracy or customer validation

real_local_kg_rag_postgres.scope: actual local KG/RAG/PG; synthetic lot/quote; not an accuracy benchmark

numeric_mechanics.scope: synthetic numbers on actual KG; no model recheck or site verification

browser.lot_and_document: synthetic only; public KG and local law/technical RAG are real
browser.provenance: literal + surrounding line, page, conversion, document hash, actor, timestamp; current-lot confirmation required
browser.task_navigation: map marker -> selected-stage actions -> mass input; all questions retained in report
browser.viewport: default and desktop prototype layout checked; temporary override reset

fault_tests: client value override and cross-tenant request
changed input invalidation and old revision preservation
wrong handoff lot mass and residue/output binding
800 kg handoff misrepresented as 1000 kg in tonne-km
trip boolean and inconsistent trip count
distinct legal and cost/carbon questions not collapsed
same-value confirmation and prompt-only edit avoid repeat KG/RAG
limitations: No real facility acceptance, current permit, transaction price or process yield verification
Synthetic quantitative fixtures are not actual cost or LCA data
Current connected workflow Azure Critic/OCR/map calls remain unvalidated live
Document literals require human review; scanned forms need separately configured OCR
Operational retention/deletion policy and automated job recovery remain unfinished
